description: This file defines the TemplateDirIterator class in the Twig templating engine, which extends the IteratorIterator class to iterate over template directories and read their contents.

classes.name: TemplateDirIterator
classes.description: A class extending IteratorIterator to iterate through template directories and retrieve file contents.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the contents of the current file in the iteration by reading it.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the key of the current element as a string.
